requirements.acceptance_criterion: 7.7.2.4 Física El patrón cumple cuando, derivado del recorrido por el centro de trabajo, se observe que sólo usan las escalas móviles cuando presenten: ¾ Condiciones de seguridad en su estructura; ¾ Peldaños completos y fijos; ¾ Materiales o características antiderrapantes en los apoyos y peldaños, y ¾ Peldaños libres de grasa, aceite u otro producto que los haga resbalosos.

requirements.plain_language: Cuando se constituya la comisión, el cargo de coordinador recaerá en el representante que designe el patrón, y el de secretario en el de los trabajadores que sea designado por el sindicato. De no existir la figura sindical, la selección del representante de los trabajadores se hará entre y por los integrantes de esta representación. Los demás miembros de la comisión serán nombrados vocales. Los nombramientos de coordinador, secretario y vocales tendrán una vigencia de dos años, y los de coordinador y secretario se alternarán entre los representantes del patrón y de los trabajadores.

requirements.plain_language: A partir de los resultados del muestreo a que se refiere el numeral 7.2, se deberán clasificar en Tipo I o Tipo II los espacios confinados, de conformidad con lo que prevé la Tabla 1 de esta Norma. Para realizar la clasificación de los espacios confinados se deberá tomar como referencia los valores límite de exposición determinados por la NOM-010-STPS-1999, o las que las sustituyan, así como la información de las hojas de datos de seguridad respectivas, con base en lo que señala la NOM-018-STPS-2000, o las que la sustituyan. Tabla 1 Tipos de espacios confinados Criterio Tipo I Tipo II Característica Riesgo potencial a la salud Riesgo grave o inminente a la mínimo salud de los trabajadores Concentración de oxígeno en Entre 19.5 y 23.5% Menor a 19.5%, o mayor a 23.5% porcentaje Características de inflamabilidad Menor que el 10% del límite Mayor o igual que el 10% del inferior de inflamabilidad y/o límite inferior de inflamabilidad y/o explosividad explosividad Toxicidad o peligro a la salud Menor que el nivel de acción (0.5 Mayor o igual al nivel de acción (concentración) VLE) (0.5 VLE) Para el propósito de la presente Norma, el espacio confinado deberá clasificarse en los tipos siguientes.
requirements.control_test: Verify this requirement against the current SPACE-ID, task, permit and field condition.
requirements.evidence_required: SPACE-ID classification/risk analysis + sampling/HDS/process evidence.
requirements.measurement_input: O2 %, %LEL/LIE, toxic concentration vs action level
requirements.formula_or_rule: Type I only if 19.5<=O2<=23.5 AND LEL<10% AND toxics<0.5*VLE; otherwise Type II
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Classification matches all three criteria.
requirements.notes: Applies when the SPACE-ID/task/work condition triggers this requirement.

requirements.plain_language: La falta de control sobre el trabajo. El control sobre el trabajo es la posibilidad que tiene el trabajador para influir y tomar decisiones en la realización de sus actividades. La iniciativa y autonomía, el uso y desarrollo de habilidades y conocimientos, la participación y manejo del cambio, así como la capacitación son aspectos que dan al trabajador la posibilidad de influir sobre su trabajo. Estos elementos, cuando son inexistentes o escasos, se convierten en un factor de riesgo. La falta de control se denomina como la escasa o inexistente posibilidad que tiene el trabajador para influir y tomar decisiones sobre los diversos aspectos que intervienen en la realización de sus actividades. Contrario a esto, la iniciativa y autonomía, el uso y desarrollo de habilidades y conocimientos, la participación y el manejo del cambio y la capacitación son elementos que dan al trabajador la posibilidad de influir sobre su trabajo. Este factor de riesgo sólo aplica en aquellos procesos y/o actividades en los que se requiere toma de decisiones y el trabajador cuenta con conocimientos y experiencia necesaria para tal efecto.

requirements.requirement_title: Acidic wastewater treatment only to meet applicable discharge conditions
requirements.plain_language: If an acidic process-water stream is legally routed to the urban/municipal sewer, condition/treat it only against the applicable discharge conditions (including pH 5.5-10.0 and any site-specific limits). A hazardous WASTE-ID cannot be discharged to sewer under 4.8; the LGPGIR no-dilution rule is separate and must not be misattributed to NOM-002.
requirements.control_test: If an acidic process-water stream is legally routed to municipal sewer, design/operate conditioning treatment only to meet applicable discharge conditions (including pH 5.5-10.0) and site-specific limits; never use dilution to dispose of hazardous waste.
requirements.evidence_required: Process characterization + treatment SOP + before/after measurements + authority conditions.
requirements.measurement_input: Influent/effluent pH, flow, composition; chemical dosing variables only after engineering basis
requirements.formula_or_rule: route must be WASTEWATER_TO_MUNICIPAL_SEWER; every simple-sample pH 5.5-10.0; all applicable pollutant/authority limits; WASTE-ID hazardous => sewer route prohibited
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Effluent meets all applicable discharge conditions; no hazardous WASTE-ID is routed to sewer; any treatment is supported by process chemistry/authority requirements.
requirements.manual_or_record: Wastewater conditioning/neutralization SOP - only after route and chemistry are approved
requirements.notes: Do not infer a universal neutralization recipe. LGPGIR Art.67(VIII) is the separate no-dilution rule for hazardous waste management.

requirements.evidence_required: Official NOM text/current date

requirements.notes: Historical transition preserved for provenance.

requirements.requirement_title: Perform technical analyses and retain three years
requirements.plain_language: Perform technical analyses of the discharge parameters needed to determine daily/monthly averages and retain analysis records at least three years after sampling.
requirements.control_test: Perform technical analyses of the discharge parameters needed to determine daily/monthly averages and retain analysis records at least three years after sampling.
requirements.evidence_required: Laboratory/technical analyses + retention metadata
requirements.measurement_input: record retention period; parameter analysis dates
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Required analyses current and records retained >=3 years.

requirements.requirement_title: Written exemption request for non-generated contaminants
requirements.plain_language: A parameter may be omitted only when ROCA demonstrates to the competent authority that its process/activity/water use does not generate or concentrate it, in writing and under protest of truth.
requirements.control_test: No parameter is silently omitted; every exemption has an authority-facing justification.
requirements.evidence_required: Written exemption filing/authority record + process basis
requirements.acceptance_criterion: The current discharge route and evidence satisfy the exact requirement.

requirements.requirement_title: Notify process changes affecting wastewater quality/volume
requirements.plain_language: Notify the competent authority, under local legislation, when process/activity changes modify authorized wastewater quality or volume.
requirements.control_test: Management-of-change trigger checks wastewater quality/volume impact and files notice when applicable.
requirements.evidence_required: Change record + authority notification/permit update
requirements.acceptance_criterion: The current discharge route and evidence satisfy the exact requirement.

requirements.plain_language: If water-efficiency/recycling concentrates pollutants and causes limit exceedance, request authority review and particular discharge conditions; do not assume the higher concentration is automatically allowed.
requirements.control_test: Concentration increase caused by water efficiency/recycling triggers authority route before continued nonconforming discharge.
requirements.evidence_required: Mass balance/process data + authority request/conditions
requirements.formula_or_rule: if recycling/efficiency causes limit exceedance -> authority particular-conditions route
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Authority route completed and current conditions stored.

requirements.requirement_title: Account for pollutants already in supply water
requirements.plain_language: When supply water already contains a regulated parameter, the demonstrated daily/monthly supply-water concentration may be added to the corresponding limit, provided it is proven and notified in writing to the authority.
requirements.control_test: Adjustment is used only with supply-water analysis and written authority notification.
requirements.evidence_required: Supply-water lab results + written notification + discharge calculation
requirements.measurement_input: supply concentration; base limit; averaging basis
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Adjusted limit used only with required proof/notification.

requirements.requirement_title: Use referenced or approved alternative test methods
requirements.plain_language: Use the Mexican test methods referenced by the NOM, or obtain competent-authority approval for an alternative method before relying on it.
requirements.control_test: Each result links to the applicable recognized method or approved alternative.
requirements.evidence_required: Lab report/method ID/alternative approval
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Method accepted and traceable.

requirements.plain_language: Generators/managers handle hazardous waste safely and environmentally adequately under LGPGIR.
requirements.control_test: Every hazardous WASTE-ID has controlled storage/route/authorized destination.
requirements.evidence_required: Waste register + storage/evidence + manifests/manager authorization.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Applicable legal requirement is supported by current evidence.

requirements.plain_language: When transferring hazardous waste to service companies/managers, verify SEMARNAT authorization is current; generator retains responsibility obligations and can share liability if unauthorized route is used.
requirements.control_test: Manager authorization verified before each controlled transfer/vendor approval.
requirements.evidence_required: Current SEMARNAT authorization + contract/manifest/transfer record.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Only authorized/current manager used.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Correct authority/category registration route completed.

requirements.requirement_title: Do not mix hazardous waste with incompatible waste/material
requirements.plain_language: Avoid mixing hazardous waste with other materials or residues when the mixture could contaminate them or cause reactions that put health, environment or natural resources at risk.
requirements.control_test: For each WASTE-ID, verify segregation/compatibility against composition/HDS/classification and storage arrangement.
requirements.evidence_required: Waste compatibility matrix + labeled storage photos + incident/spill log where applicable.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Incompatible materials physically/operationally separated.

requirements.plain_language: For products/wastes under management plans, prevent/respond safely to leaks/spills/releases during transport/collection.
requirements.control_test: For products/wastes under management plans, prevent/respond safely to leaks/spills/releases during transport/collection.
requirements.evidence_required: Spill response procedure/equipment/manager evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Response resources/procedure exist for actual route.

requirements.requirement_title: No confinement of liquid/semi-solid hazardous waste without required prior treatment
requirements.plain_language: Do not place liquid or semisolid hazardous waste into confinement unless it has received the prior treatment required to remove moisture, neutralize or stabilize it and achieve solidification under applicable law. This is a confinement rule, not blanket authorization to neutralize and discharge waste.
requirements.control_test: If confinement is the selected/authorized final-disposal route, verify required pre-treatment/solidification evidence; otherwise mark this confinement-specific control not applicable to that WASTE-ID route.
requirements.evidence_required: Waste route + treatment/confinement authorization/manager evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Confinement route either does not apply, or required lawful pre-treatment/solidification is documented before confinement.
requirements.notes: Never interpret this article as a general instruction to add base to acidic workshop waste before disposal.

requirements.requirement_title: Hazardous waste storage <=6 months at generator
requirements.plain_language: Do not store hazardous waste at the generating source for more than six months unless an applicable authorized exception exists.
requirements.control_test: Do not store hazardous waste at the generating source for more than six months unless an applicable authorized exception exists.
requirements.evidence_required: Container/WASTE-ID dates + log + manifest/exception.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No WASTE-ID exceeds six months without documented legal exception.

requirements.plain_language: Do not confine incompatible hazardous waste in same place/cell or exceed installed capacity.
requirements.control_test: Do not confine incompatible hazardous waste in same place/cell or exceed installed capacity.
requirements.evidence_required: Compatibility/capacity records + field evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Compatibility and capacity controls pass.

requirements.plain_language: Do not dilute hazardous waste in any medium merely to reduce its concentration or avoid classification/limits, unless the dilution is legitimately part of an authorized treatment.
requirements.control_test: Review any water/base/solvent/addition to a hazardous WASTE-ID and verify it is not dilution-to-comply; if part of treatment, require the treatment legal/technical dossier.
requirements.evidence_required: Treatment route/authorization/process record.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No disposal-driven dilution.

requirements.plain_language: If hazardous-material/waste generation, handling, release or discharge contaminates a site, responsible parties must address damage/remediation under applicable law.
requirements.control_test: If hazardous-material/waste generation, handling, release or discharge contaminates a site, responsible parties must address damage/remediation under applicable law.
requirements.evidence_required: Incident/site investigation + authority/remediation records.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Triggered contamination is escalated and managed under remediation route.

requirements.plain_language: Treat containers/packaging that held hazardous waste or hazardous materials as hazardous waste when they are not reused for the same purpose/material, except where properly treated for reuse/recycling/final disposal; never reuse them for water, food or human/animal consumption products.
requirements.control_test: Classify every empty chemical container by prior contents and intended reuse; prohibit food/water reuse.
requirements.evidence_required: CHEM-ID/WASTE-ID container register + HDS + labeled container photos + disposition record.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No hazardous-container residue is misclassified or reused for prohibited purposes.

requirements.plain_language: Do not store hazardous waste at the generating source for more than six months from generation unless a lawful extension is requested/granted as applicable; record generation/storage dates in the corresponding log.
requirements.control_test: Do not store hazardous waste at the generating source for more than six months from generation unless a lawful extension is requested/granted as applicable; record generation/storage dates in the corresponding log.
requirements.evidence_required: Waste log + container label/date + transporter/receipt/manifest or extension file.
requirements.measurement_input: waste generation date; current/dispatch date; extension status
requirements.formula_or_rule: storage_age_days<=~183 unless valid extension route applies
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No hazardous WASTE-ID exceeds six months without applicable authorized extension.

requirements.requirement_title: On-site hazardous-waste recycling notice / authorization trigger
requirements.plain_language: Before recycling hazardous waste on the same property where generated, present the required technical report to SEMARNAT at least 30 days in advance; if the process releases contaminants and poses health risk, determine the prior-authorization route.
requirements.control_test: Before recycling hazardous waste on the same property where generated, present the required technical report to SEMARNAT at least 30 days in advance; if the process releases contaminants and poses health risk, determine the prior-authorization route.
requirements.evidence_required: Technical report + filing receipt + process description + authority response/authorization if applicable.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No triggered on-site hazardous-waste recycling begins without the applicable advance filing/authorization route.

requirements.plain_language: If ROCA performs physical, chemical or biological treatment of hazardous waste, present to SEMARNAT the procedures, methods or techniques, considering potential release of toxic substances and proposed prevention/reduction measures, under applicable rules.
requirements.control_test: Before designing/operating an on-site hazardous-waste treatment such as neutralization, first confirm WASTE-ID classification and determine the required SEMARNAT filing/authorization pathway.
requirements.evidence_required: WASTE-ID classification + treatment basis + HDS/compatibility + technical procedure + SEMARNAT filing/authority record.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No on-site hazardous-waste treatment is treated as an informal workshop step; legal/technical route is resolved first.
requirements.notes: Do not infer a universal neutralization recipe. Exact chemistry, dose, heat/gas evolution, endpoint and residue disposition require waste-specific technical basis and applicable authority route.

requirements.formula_or_rule: trigger -> classify change -> if SEMARNAT-07-031 applies, open modification filing
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No material registration/authorization change is treated as silently updating an old record; applicable modification route is documented and filed.
requirements.notes: Current official SEMARNAT search route for SEMARNAT-07-031 verified 2026-09-29; exact filing applicability remains conditional on the change.

requirements.evidence_required: Data dictionary / claim review / source crosswalk.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Controlled vocabulary matches current legal concepts.

requirements.plain_language: Do not treat REP as active for a ROCA product merely because LGEC exists; determine whether SEMARNAT has published an applicable General Agreement for the relevant sector/product.
requirements.control_test: Search current DOF/SEMARNAT General Agreements and map every ROCA product family/imported product to included/excluded/unresolved.
requirements.evidence_required: Current General Agreement search log + product-family register.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Each product family has dated REP trigger status with source.

requirements.requirement_title: Respond to lawful REP-agreement information request
requirements.plain_language: If SEMARNAT requests sector/product information for preparation of a General Agreement and ROCA is an addressed producer/importer, provide the required information through the lawful channel.
requirements.control_test: Track formal authority request, scope, due date, response and proof of delivery.
requirements.evidence_required: Official request + controlled response + submission receipt.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: If triggered, response is complete and submitted by the stated deadline.

requirements.requirement_title: Comply with applicable REP General Agreement
requirements.plain_language: A producer/importer included in an applicable General Agreement is subject to its REP requirements.
requirements.control_test: Once a General Agreement applies, instantiate each agreement requirement as product-specific REQ rows rather than relying on this generic row.
requirements.evidence_required: Applicable published General Agreement + product mapping + derived requirement set.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No applicable agreement remains unparsed; all its company obligations are executable in the app.

requirements.requirement_title: Concertation agreement is optional unless chosen/required by implementation path
requirements.plain_language: A producer/importer may enter a concertation agreement with SEMARNAT; do not present this optional path as a universal mandatory filing.
requirements.control_test: Only create a concertation workflow if management selects it or the applicable REP implementation requires it.
requirements.evidence_required: Management decision / applicable REP route.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Optional route is not misrepresented as mandatory.

requirements.requirement_title: Prepare Circular Management and request Registry inscription when REP agreement applies
requirements.plain_language: When an applicable REP General Agreement is published, covered producers/importers or coordinating body must prepare Circular Management and request registration within the agreement deadlines.
requirements.control_test: Agreement trigger creates LIC/FORM workflow with due date, product scope, required Circular Management package and Registry submission.
requirements.evidence_required: Applicable agreement + Circular Management dossier + registration submission/receipt.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: If triggered, dossier and registration are submitted within the applicable agreement deadline.

requirements.requirement_title: Implement mechanisms, targets and indicators from applicable REP agreement
requirements.plain_language: For covered products, implement the direct/indirect circularity mechanisms, targets, indicators and methodologies established by the applicable General Agreement/registration/concertation agreement.
requirements.control_test: Translate every target and indicator into measurable app fields, owner, frequency and evidence.
requirements.evidence_required: Agreement/registration conditions + metric records + implementation evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every applicable target has current measurement, owner, evidence and status.

requirements.plain_language: When applying for Circular Management registration, identify existing compatible current permits/authorizations or LGPGIR management plans so the authority can recognize information already on file.
requirements.control_test: Cross-reference current environmental permits/plans to the registration dossier; do not re-invent facts inconsistently.
requirements.evidence_required: Permit/authorization/plan register + dossier crosswalk.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Compatible instruments are current, consistent and linked.

requirements.requirement_title: Truthful information in Circular Management filing
requirements.plain_language: Do not submit false information in a Circular Management application; false information is an express ground for denial.
requirements.control_test: Maker-checker review validates every factual field and attachment before filing.
requirements.evidence_required: Source-backed form fields + checker signoff + submission version.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: 100% factual filing fields have source/evidence and checker signoff.

requirements.plain_language: For a Circular Management filing, track the 60-business-day period specified by the law and the actual legal status; do not assume tacit registration without confirming the filing date/conditions and current administrative record.
requirements.control_test: For a Circular Management filing, track the 60-business-day period specified by the law and the actual legal status; do not assume tacit registration without confirming the filing date/conditions and current administrative record.
requirements.evidence_required: Platform upload/receipt + authority communications/status.
requirements.measurement_input: Verified upload/submission date; business days elapsed; authority status
requirements.formula_or_rule: statutory reference: 60 business days from upload for inscription rule, subject to complete/current filing record
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Scheduler uses verified filing date and records actual authority status/evidence.

requirements.requirement_title: Life-cycle analysis/study in Circular Management filing
requirements.plain_language: Include product-category life-cycle analysis, or an allowed simplified life-cycle study only where the applicable REP agreement/concertation route permits it.
requirements.control_test: Registration checklist contains the exact triggered field/attachment and source evidence.
requirements.evidence_required: Controlled registration dossier / applicable agreement.

requirements.requirement_title: REP registration reporting and review obligations
requirements.plain_language: After registration, provide the reports required by the applicable REP General Agreement and registered/concerted conditions; track reviews that may ratify, modify or cancel registration.
requirements.control_test: Create reporting calendar only from actual registration/agreement conditions and track submissions/reviews.
requirements.evidence_required: Registration conditions + reporting calendar + submitted reports/receipts + authority decisions.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: All triggered reports are filed by the applicable deadline and current registration status is reflected.

requirements.requirement_title: National Circular Economy Distinctive is optional and authorization-dependent
requirements.plain_language: Do not display or market the National Circular Economy Distinctive unless SEMARNAT has authorized its use; if management pursues it, build the voluntary audit/authorization workflow and track its three-year validity.
requirements.control_test: Public product/marketing review confirms no unauthorized distinctive; voluntary application only if deliberately selected.
requirements.evidence_required: Marketing/product artwork review; if used, authorization and validity evidence.
requirements.formula_or_rule: if authorized: validity=3 years subject to applicable renewal/conditions
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No unauthorized use; if authorized, current evidence exists.

requirements.plain_language: Treat environmental audit under LGEC as a voluntary improvement route, not proof of mandatory compliance or a universal filing requirement.
requirements.control_test: Only create the audit workflow if management elects it; keep its result separate from mandatory compliance.
requirements.evidence_required: Management decision / audit agreement/report if used.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Voluntary audit is correctly classified and not represented as mandatory.

requirements.requirement_title: Circular design/REP business duty is agreement-conditioned in execution
requirements.plain_language: Productive sectors must develop circular design when environmentally, technically and economically viable and implement circular-economy policies/principles under REP according to applicable General Agreements/concertation agreements.
requirements.control_test: For each product family, resolve REP agreement trigger first; if triggered, document circular-design viability and resulting controls/targets.
requirements.evidence_required: Product-family register + applicable agreement + design/viability record + implementation evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No triggered product lacks a documented design/REP implementation route.

requirements.plain_language: Where REP/product rules apply, producers/importers organize, promote and where applicable finance circular-economy schemes for products generated/imported, complementing LGPGIR responsibilities.
requirements.control_test: Applicable REP scheme has operating model, owner, cost/funding evidence, material/residue traceability and LGPGIR crosswalk.
requirements.evidence_required: REP agreement/registration + scheme records + finance/contract/material evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Triggered scheme is operational, financed where required and traceable.

requirements.plain_language: Covered producers/importers may use an Organismo Coordinador to support REP compliance when the applicable scheme/agreements permit it; do not assume ROCA must create one.
requirements.control_test: Only create coordinating-body workflow if the applicable REP route and management decision use it; verify legal/personality/representation evidence and its registered responsibilities.
requirements.evidence_required: Applicable REP agreement + coordinating-body legal/representation documents + registered Circular Management responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: If used, coordinating organization is authorized/traceable for the exact REP scope; otherwise this route stays inactive.

requirements.requirement_title: Register Circular Management in National Platform when obligation is triggered
requirements.plain_language: A producer/importer or coordinating body subject to the registration route must register Circular Management in the National Platform.
requirements.control_test: Registration workflow is created only after applicable REP trigger is verified.
requirements.evidence_required: Applicable agreement/trigger + registration receipt/status.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: If triggered, current registration evidence exists.

requirements.requirement_title: Record direct vs indirect REP compliance mode
requirements.plain_language: For a triggered REP obligation, classify each mechanism as direct or indirect and retain the agreement/third-party evidence for indirect compliance.
requirements.control_test: Every applicable REP mechanism has compliance_mode and evidence/third-party link where indirect.
requirements.evidence_required: Registered Circular Management + mechanism evidence/contracts.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every mechanism is classified and evidence-backed.

requirements.requirement_title: Environmental compensation only through applicable authorized REP route
requirements.plain_language: Do not self-declare environmental compensation as a substitute for REP. Use compensation only where applicable General Agreements/regulations/registered Circular Management establish the case, criteria and conditions.
requirements.control_test: Any compensation route is supported by applicable agreement/registration/authority condition and proportionality evidence.
requirements.evidence_required: Applicable legal/registration basis + compensation evidence + indicator results.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No unsupported compensation is counted as REP compliance.

requirements.plain_language: Do not generate or use false information about environmental characteristics of products.
requirements.control_test: Review website, quotes, catalog, labels, PDFs and marketing claims against documented evidence before publication.
requirements.evidence_required: Claim ledger: exact claim, source evidence, reviewer, publication surface/version.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every environmental product claim is evidence-backed; unsupported claims are removed/corrected.

requirements.plain_language: Do not claim a process follows circular-economy criteria/principles when that information is false.
requirements.control_test: Any circularity/process statement is tied to actual process/material/residue evidence and reviewed before publication.
requirements.evidence_required: Process claim ledger + operational/evidence IDs.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No circularity/process claim exceeds the evidence.

requirements.requirement_title: Do not obstruct product life extension/circular utilization
requirements.plain_language: Do not take or omit actions that prevent maximization of product useful life and circular utilization; translate this into product/service/waste decisions only with concrete evidence and applicable technical boundaries.
requirements.control_test: For ROCA-created products/packaging/derivatives, document practical repair/reuse/recovery/disposition decisions and any justified technical/environmental limitation; do not invent universal design targets.
requirements.evidence_required: Product/material-flow records, repair/reuse/disposition SOPs, justified exceptions.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No known operational practice intentionally blocks feasible product-life/circular-utilization route without documented technical/environmental reason.

requirements.requirement_title: No unauthorized or confusing circular-economy distinctive
requirements.plain_language: Do not use the National Circular Economy Distinctive without authorization and do not use a confusingly similar label/distinctive.
requirements.control_test: Brand/label review checks unauthorized official distinctive or confusing equivalent before publication/printing.
requirements.evidence_required: Artwork/label/site review + authorization if applicable.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No unauthorized/confusing distinctive appears.

requirements.requirement_title: Provide reports/documents required by registered Circular Management
requirements.plain_language: If ROCA is a registered obligated producer/importer, provide the reports/documents required by its registered Circular Management within applicable deadlines.
requirements.control_test: Reporting calendar is populated from actual registration obligations, not generic assumptions.
requirements.evidence_required: Registration conditions + report/receipt records.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every triggered report/document submitted by applicable deadline.

requirements.requirement_title: Treat violations/authority resolution as management/legal events
requirements.plain_language: If an LGEC enforcement event occurs, preserve authority record, legal response, corrective action and any alternative dispute-resolution mechanism; do not expose legal case details to workshop users.
requirements.control_test: Restricted legal case/control exists only if enforcement event occurs.
requirements.evidence_required: Authority notices/resolutions + legal response + CAPA, restricted access.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: If triggered, case is controlled and corrective actions are tracked.

requirements.plain_language: If an applicable General Agreement or concertation agreement establishes differentiated graduality, load its actual milestones and conditions into the app; do not create self-selected extensions.

requirements.evidence_required: Applicable agreement/registration/concertation + milestone evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No schedule extension/graduality is assumed without legal/administrative basis.
